items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I told Rex, I said nobody

ctx.x: Especially the ones who stayed around him for a while. He sure wrote for Rex. I told Rex, I said nobody

will ever write for you like that again. He said I know it, you know. They knew it. They knew it. But Duke would have to hear you long enough to know exactly what you were doing, what your strong points were and your weak points. You'd have to be with him that long. He wouldn't do it right away. You'd have to be with him for a while before he did it.
